final_message:
`register()` now takes an optional `mode` argument, and a name collision with a different class is handled according to it. The change is in `src/vunnel/providers/__init__.py`.

- **`PluginOverrideMode`:** an enum with `FAIL`, `REPLACE` and `IGNORE`. `PluginOverrideMode.from_env()` reads `VUNNEL_PLUGIN_OVERRIDE_MODE` case-insensitively. Unset, empty or unknown values give `FAIL`.
- **`register(name, cls, mode=None)`:** with no `mode`, it reads the environment each time it's called. On a collision with a different class, `FAIL` raises `KeyError` as before, `REPLACE` lets the new class win, and `IGNORE` keeps the existing one. Names that don't collide register normally in every mode.

I ran the existing `tests/unit/test_provider.py` and `tests/unit/cli` suites, and all 111 tests passed. I also tried `REPLACE` by setting `VUNNEL_PLUGIN_OVERRIDE_MODE=Replace` and registering a dummy class over `nvd`. The dummy class replaced the built-in provider. I did not run the `FAIL` and `IGNORE` paths, and I added no new tests.

`pytest` only finds `vunnel` if you set `PYTHONPATH=src`. I used that for every run.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root with the one-sentence summary.

steps.command: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_providers.py 2>&1 | tail -5; git stash -q; PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_providers.py 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q
git status --short; ls tests/unit | head -30; grep -rl "register" tests/unit | head

PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_provider.py tests/unit/cli 2>&1 | tail -3
PYTHONPATH=src VUNNEL_PLUGIN_OVERRIDE_MODE=Replace .venv/bin/python -c "
from vunnel import providers as p
class X: pass
p.register('nvd',X); print(p._providers['nvd'])
p.register('nvd',p.nvd.Provider,p.PluginOverrideMode.FAIL) if False else None
"
